title: yliveticker · Yahoo Finance
description: Live Yahoo Finance ticks from an east-to-west global watchlist are stored in InfluxDB 2 (ticker_data). SYNTH-* prices appear only in the explicit synthetic test feed.

options.content: Ticks are stored in **InfluxDB** · bucket `ticker_data`. **Unofficial Yahoo WebSocket feed: no availability, completeness or timeliness promises.** Select symbols above; chart info bubbles contain country, currency and UTC regular hours. Configured silent symbols stay visible. `SYNTH-*` is opt-in testing only. [Quickstart and limitations](https://github.com/yahoofinancelive/yliveticker/blob/main/docker/README.md).

from(bucket: "ticker_data")

panels.title: Time since last tick
panels.description: Receipt age is time since the collector received a message; quote age uses Yahoo's timestamp. All configured symbols appear, including never-seen symbols. Status is observational; regular hours are estimates, not a holiday calendar or proof of Yahoo support. A stale heartbeat means collector/storage status is unknown. Counts are per collector run. No support/availability promises.

from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker" and r._field == "volume_available")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.id, set: ["BTC-USD", "EURUSD=X", "GC=F", "FPH.NZ", "BHP.AX", "7203.T", "0700.HK", "D05.SI", "RELIANCE.NS", "EMAAR.AE", "NPN.JO", "SAP.DE", "HSBA.L", "AAPL", "NVDA", "SHOP.TO", "VALE3.SA"]))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => symbolLabel(id: r.id) =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["id"])
  |> last()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: symbolLabel(id: r.id) + "|" + sessionInfo(id: r.id)}))
  |> group()
  |> distinct()

from(bucket: "ticker_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ticker" and r._field == "volume_available")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.id, set: ["BTC-USD", "EURUSD=X", "GC=F", "FPH.NZ", "BHP.AX", "7203.T", "0700.HK", "D05.SI", "RELIANCE.NS", "EMAAR.AE", "NPN.JO", "SAP.DE", "HSBA.L", "AAPL", "NVDA", "SHOP.TO", "VALE3.SA"]))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => symbolLabel(id: r.id) =~ /^${symbol:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["id"])
  |> last()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: symbolLabel(id: r.id) + "|" + sessionInfo(id: r.id)}))
  |> group()
  |> distinct()
